app: True Eve - Glow Up Face Rating

reviews.title: Bro
reviews.text: OK, so they deleted my original review. I just wanna put this back out there do not get this app. It is not free regardless of the fact that it’s advertised as free. They basically call you ugly. They’ll probably delete this one too, but oh well I hope you guys see this.

reviews.title: Useless, ChatGPT does better
reviews.text: This app doesn’t provide you with any useful information + you have to pay for it. It will tell you to drink more water, wear makeup, and get a haircut. Which like I already do all of those and I’m aware that I look better with my hair done? Lol. I should’ve read the reviews before I bought this. Whoopsie.

reviews.title: Not free and useless!!
reviews.text: I can’t believe they make us pay for this app. I used it for more than a month and it wasn’t working, so I canceled my payment and left it. Would not recommend using and don’t waste your money or time on the app.

reviews.title: why is this app made
reviews.text: ok i downloaded this app for the giggles but i quite literally wasted my time and just got absolutely flabbergasted. ok first if all there shouldnt be apps that make u think ur ugly like im sorry WHAT. and these glow up apps should be more about feeling good from the inside and learning self care and self love. literally the first couple of minutes it asked “will u pinky promise to follow the glowup routine” and the options to answer was yes and “no i will be lazy and stay ugly forever”…..WOAH WOHA WOAH WHAT. who in the right mind makes an app like that. theres actual people insecure about how they look. imagine theres probably someone that downloaded the app, thought it was free, got insulted, and realized it was quite frankly NOT FREE.😭

reviews.title: Waste of Time
reviews.text: wasted a good 5 minutes of my life picking options and taking a front/side photo just for it to end up being a subscription to get a result that is most likely inaccurate

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This app is not free and a total waste of your time if you want a free app
